verdict.rationale: BigCommerce's own Tools & SDKs page lists official SDKs, including the Checkout SDK (checkout-sdk-js) and API Clients for making requests 'in the language of your choice'. It also offers an open-source design system for building native control-panel apps. Missing for 10: the specific languages and SDK depth are not documented in the pack, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Get started making API requests in the language of your choice with our API Clients.
Our open source design system. Use to build BigCommerce Apps that feel native inside the control panel.
